component.name: DD Flash
component.summary: Modern GUI for safely writing ISO/IMG images to USB drives

description.p: DD Flash is a modern, minimalist GTK4/Libadwaita application for safely writing ISO and IMG disk images to USB drives. It provides a simple, intuitive interface with real-time progress monitoring and comprehensive safety checks to prevent accidental data loss.

ul.li: Real-time progress with speed and ETA display
Comprehensive safety checks to prevent flashing to system disks
Polkit integration for secure privilege escalation
